description: Eliminate EXTRA_TRIGGERS hardcoding — body text fallback mines backtick/quoted phrases from skill body for sparse-description skills. Generator now fully self-maintaining for any new skill added.

name: WibWobWorld 3D tab frame rate — raycaster + terrain cache optimization

description: Baseline: STEPS=1000, cos/sin recomputed per step per column. Terrain creation adds 40ms overhead on every render() call.
Precompute per-column ray directions: cos/sin computed once per column instead of 1000× per column. -44% raycaster time, -55% full round-trip.
Terrain cache in render(): skip createTerrainMap on camera-only renders. Zero visual change — terrain is deterministic from seed/terrainIdx/seaLevel/size.
Active-col counter: break step loop when all columns filled. Remove optional chaining in hot path. Zero visual change — skips steps that would only overdraw already-filled pixels.

Sky parallax + flight mode. frame_µs up from 4767 due to world-space wx=skyXOff+col computed per sky pixel (replaces static col). Real cost of correctness — sky now actually rotates with camera. Still -34% from baseline.
Re-baseline with stable bench (7-sample minimum). All prior optimisations in: precomputed rays, active-col exit, terrain cache, parallax sky, flight mode.
Incremental wx/wxI in sky loop: float-add + Math.floor eliminated per sky pixel, replaced with loop increments. Zero visual change.
Hash noise (Math.imul smoothstep) vs trig noise2d: identical speed — Bun JIT optimises sin/cos as well as integer hash. No benefit, changes cloud patterns. Revert.
STEPS 1000→500: -35% raycaster. Terrain cells are 1-unit, still 7x oversampled at FAR. No gap artifacts across 3 terrain types. Active-col exit already short-circuits near scenes anyway.
STEPS 500→300: -34% more. No gap artifacts across 5 terrain seeds. At FAR≈72 we're still 4x oversampled per terrain cell. Active-col exit makes this nearly free for near scenes.
STEPS 300→200: -19% more. No gaps across 5 terrain types × 3 yaw angles. At FAR≈72 still 2.8x oversampled. Sample spread now very tight (1337-1429µs in best 4/7).
STEPS 200→150: -10% more. No gaps across 6 terrains × 4 camera positions. FAR≈72, step=0.48 units — still 2× oversampled per terrain cell.
STEPS=120: 56 gap runs across archipelago terrain at multiple angles. Quality floor hit. STEPS=150 confirmed as minimum safe value. Reverted.
Hoist invDepth + dNear/dMid/dFarCliff per step: eliminates division per column, 2 float comparisons per column. Zero quality change.
